title: AOP2 ASCwrap Mailbox Handshake & Hardware Protocol Specification

trigger_sequence: 1. Host or coprocessor formats 64-bit message in local memory.
3. Writer executes ARM64 'dmb ishst' memory barrier.
4. Writer sets target bit in DOORBELL_SET (+0x0000) to trigger destination core interrupt.
5. Reader receives hardware interrupt (e.g. 0x0166 on AP, 0x0168 on AOP2).
6. Reader reads MBI_INBOX_DATA (+0x0008), which dequeues message from hardware FIFO.
7. Reader writes acknowledgment bit to DOORBELL_CLEAR (+0x0004).

states.description: AOP2 core held in reset by SoC Power Management IC; DRAM clocks gated.
AOP2 executes RTKit microkernel preload at 0xffffffff00000800; configures EL1 vector tables and MMIO.

steps: AOP2 transmits SYS_HELLO (Opcode 0x01) on EP 0x00 declaring protocol v3, build RaveB24B119.
Host verifies version compatibility and responds with SYS_HELLO_ACK (Opcode 0x02).
For each active endpoint (0x01..0x53), host transmits SYS_EP_CONFIG with physical descriptor ring address.
AOP2 maps shared memory via DART-AOP (SID 0x10) and responds with SYS_EP_READY.
Host transmits SYS_TIME_SYNC with current mach_continuous_time timestamp.
AOP2 synchronizes its 24 MHz hardware counter offset.

states.description: All endpoints active; sensor fast-path streams and audio buffers operate autonomously.

historical_queue.role: Retains motion and audio frames during host sleep; transferred in bulk upon wake.

crashdump_protocol.panic_trigger: Triggered upon unrecoverable kernel assertion, memory tag violation, or watchdog expiration.
crashdump_protocol.register_dump: AOP2 microkernel dumps PC, SP, FAR_EL1, ESR_EL1, and x0..x30 registers into _rtk_exc_stack.
crashdump_protocol.panic_notification: AOP2 sends SYS_CRASHLOG_PANIC (Opcode 0x08) on EP 0x00 and triggers host doorbell.
crashdump_protocol.host_reclamation: Host Darwin AppleAOP2 driver extracts crash payload and generates system diagnostic report.
